subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the person by the water

746690101.text: Have faith in yourself, Bresson... Have faith. All the tools have been prepared...

746690102.text: You just need to... go underwater. Yes, underwater... Go there and prove that these tools are reliable, and your work will be complete!

746690104.text: Eh? Where did you come from? I didn't hear you coming at all!

746690105.text: I almost fell into the water, you know — if I hadn't regained my balance, the future of photography in Fontaine would have gone down the... water!

746690108.text: Wait, don't you know how to swim?

746690109.text: And you're from Fontaine, aren't you?

746690110.text: Who... Who said that people from Fontaine must know how to swim? Not every person from Liyue can cook, and not every Mondstadter's a poet!

746690111.text: Whatever. I went through all this effort to get diving apparatus. Today, I must go underwater to take some pictures...

746690112.text: Oh, so that's what going on...

746690113.text: Is there something special about this Kamera?

746690114.text: Special? I, Bresson Cartier, modified the Kamera personally. This is why it's "special."

746690115.text: My modification techniques are strict and ingenious, and I only use the very finest materials.

746690131.text: The lens is countless times better than those you'll find on any other Kameras. Indeed, there will be no loss in image quality even if you go underwater!

746690116.text: But those people in the Kamera Club... They don't care about my new techniques at all. They claim that the key to photography lies in the skill of the photographers themselves, and not their tools...

746690117.text: But just you wait, I say. I will take some brilliant pictures, and shut those ignoramuses right up!

746690118.text: Phew... Come on, Bresson. Believe in yourself... Believe... the water is warm and comfy, and it's definitely not full of man-eating fish...

746690119.text: I... I... Ugh, will this divesuit really work? Will it suddenly explode underwater!?

746690120.text: After which I shall be dragged into the watery depths, never to be seen again... I... Oh, Archons...
